These are synthetic controller HTTP responses, not captures from the tester.

The zone IDs, names, track and artwork key come from the Roon event excerpt attached to #291. The stopped MacBook zone has no now-playing or volume control; the playing Gustard also has no volume control. The HTTP shape and null/default behavior follow [`src/knobs/routes.rs` at UHC `v4.0.0-beta.7`](https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/unified-hifi-control/blob/v4.0.0-beta.7/src/knobs/routes.rs) (`ZoneInfo`, `NowPlayingResponse`, and `knob_now_playing_handler`). The bridge prefixes Roon IDs and projects media into top-level fields. Its zone summaries do not contain `now_playing`.

The fixtures test the empty-zone hypothesis without pretending raw Roon CONTINUE events are the firmware API. They cannot establish the cause of the tester's intermittent failure without failing HTTP/serial evidence and exact-artifact hardware validation.

The integration contract is exercised in `tests/test_connection_runtime.c` against the production client, under ASan/UBSan:

- Each accepted playback reply starts from defaults. A recognizable top-level title (including null), playing boolean, or volume type is required. Legacy replies may omit `zone_id`; a present ID must match exactly. Unknown extension fields remain supported. Omitted optional fields clear/reset rather than retaining another snapshot's values.
- Volume adjustment requires a current finite value/min/max/step tuple, an adjustable type, ordered bounds, a value inside those bounds and a positive step no larger than the range. Invalid, missing, fixed and unknown capabilities are inert. Progress is a nonnegative integer within `int` range.
- Request context and queued media/zone presentations are fenced by configuration revision, endpoint generation, runtime selection generation, network epoch and actual endpoint/zone. Older queued media also cannot replace a newer accepted snapshot. Volume authority and queued media expire after 90 seconds.
- Zone probes and inventory use the same decoder. Cosmetic missing names fall back to IDs, invalid siblings are skipped, duplicate IDs reject the document, and IDs that cannot fit losslessly are skipped. A nonempty list with no usable entries is invalid; `[]` is valid empty. The selected zone is retained when the 64-entry inventory cap is reached. Invalid input preserves the previous inventory but removes current readiness.
- Artwork identity is owned losslessly up to 4096 bytes. Renderers receive a compact opaque token based on full-key change detection and a full-value fingerprint. The raw provider key is not an image URL on the device: artwork requests use the selected zone. Longer keys reject the snapshot explicitly. Tests cover URLs equal through byte 127 and differing later, repeated identical keys, empty/idle art and reboot token reuse.
- Before recursive cJSON parsing, documents are limited to 256 KiB, 16 container levels and 4096 structural tokens. Trailing input, embedded NULs, duplicate top-level keys and non-null top-level API errors are rejected. Allocation failures fail closed. These are parser budgets, not physical-device stack/memory validation.
- Zone change markers advance only after valid inventory publication, including valid empty inventory. Invalid refreshes retry the same marker. Connection diagnostics report a bounded failure category and last-good age; malformed playback is distinguished from transport failure.

These tests are synthetic contract counterexamples. They do not establish the cause of #291 or replace exact-artifact testing on hardware.
